tasks.label: Update receipt files
args:
const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'); const root=process.cwd(); const receipt=String.raw`<%- include('../partials/head') %> <%- include('../partials/nav') %>

Barako Brew

Coffee Shop Receipt

Receipt No.<%= sale.receipt_no %>
Queue No.<%= sale.queue_no %>
Order Type<%= sale.order_type %>
Date<%= new Date(sale.created_at).toLocaleString('en-PH', { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' }) %>
Cashier<%= sale.cashier_name || 'Unknown' %>
<% items.forEach(item => { %> <% }) %>
ItemQtyPriceSubtotal
<%= item.product_name %><%= item.quantity %><%= peso(item.unit_price) %><%= peso(item.subtotal) %>
Total<%= peso(sale.total_amount) %>
Amount Paid<%= peso(sale.amount_paid) %>
Change<%= peso(sale.change_amount) %>
New Sale
<%- include('../partials/foot') %> `; fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root,'src','views','pos','receipt.ejs'),receipt,'utf8'); const controllerPath=path.join(root,'src','controllers','posController.js'); let controller=fs.readFileSync(controllerPath,'utf8'); const old=" const { rows } = await query('SELECT * FROM sales WHERE id = $1', [req.params.id]);"; const replacement=" const { rows } = await query(\"SELECT sales.*, users.full_name AS cashier_name FROM sales LEFT JOIN users ON users.id = sales.user_id WHERE sales.id = $1\", [req.params.id]);"; if(!controller.includes(old)) throw new Error('Expected viewReceipt sale query was not found.'); fs.writeFileSync(controllerPath,controller.replace(old,replacement),'utf8'); console.log('Updated receipt.ejs and viewReceipt query.');
